summary: Per-trial divisor census over all 488 GT23 trials, then a post hoc screen of the 61 matched trials. After the screen: exact 8, unique-estimate 27, ambiguous 148 (122 + 26 re-classed), no-match 2, unreliable 303. Trials with an established divisor (rescalable): 35 of 488; 25 if matches with another recorded mass just outside the band are also left out (before the screen 61 / 38). Rescale factors (divisor / own README mass) 0.7112-1.5874. Screen (rules fixed before the read): at least 10 gait stances, and a second mass-free estimator (fitted talus point, no model or joint angles; bias 1.0035, robust sd 0.0099 log on the 8 exact trials) must lie within the +/-4.9 % band of the matched mass and be nearest to it. Dropped 26: 10 four-stance stairs trials (AB08 x3 incl. stairs_1_5 with factor 0.711, AB09 x7) and 16 trials where the second estimate is nearer another mass or outside the band (e.g. AB07 normal_walk_1 80.9 kg -> 82.2; AB01 tire_run_1 66.9 vs 78.9; AB03 cutting_1 96.9 vs 113.5; AB13 tire_run_1 70.7 vs 78.9). Both estimators are calibrated only on level walking; in dynamic trials (tire run, cutting) they can disagree by 10-15 %. Powers: published power = 6 Hz low-pass-filtered moment x velocity (verifier: ratio 1.0000, corr 1.0000 in 12 columns); the filter is linear, so each trial's rescale factor applies to all its powers (hip, knee, ankle). Census ankle check: 448/448 within 5 %. Trials without an established divisor keep kinematics and forces; only their moments and powers are withheld. Nothing rescaled or excluded in the data; no data written.

verdict.powers: Published Joint_Powers = 6 Hz low-pass (zero-lag Butterworth) moment x velocity (verifier round 1, ratio 1.0000, corr 1.0000 in 12 knee/ankle columns). The filter is linear, so each trial's rescale factor applies to all powers of that trial. The raw-moment knee ratio 0.83-1.03 in the census is the filter's effect on high-frequency knee moments, not a different divisor.

tolerance.fixed_before_data: rules{} in the audit, stamped rules_fixed_at_utc before the first trial read of each run; values read from the GT23-C03 audit tolerance_v2 (sha256 recorded), not recomputed: ankle bias 0.9942, band half width 0.0488 log (about +/-4.9 %), exact re-run corr >= 0.9999 and table match within 0.1 %, reliable families = the 14 C03 locomotion families minus curb_up/curb_down, ankle corr >= 0.98, >= 4 gait stances. Table masses within 0.5 % of each other (78.9/79.1, 67.5/67.6) count as one value; divisor = the nearest one (effect <= 0.25 %).
tolerance.changed_after_pilots: Only the power check (not a class gate) changed between pilots: pilot 1 used d(angle)/dt with |log slope| <= 0.02 and corr >= 0.98 and failed on filtering differences; pilot 2 switched to the published joint velocity; pilot 3 used the median top-quartile ratio for all columns, and knee columns read 3-17 % low in trials whose ankle ratio is 1.00; pilot 4 (the bound code) tests ankle columns only and records knee. Moment classes were identical in pilots 1-4 (exact 2, unique 9, ambiguous 22, unreliable 50 for AB05+AB12).
tolerance.added_after_census: sensitivity block (fragile = another README mass within one C03 robust sd, 0.0152 log, outside the band): 23 of 53 unique-estimates. Reads only the audit JSON; census classes unchanged.
tolerance.honesty_note: Pilot subjects AB05 and AB12 were chosen because their C03 anomalies (AB05 incline ~115 kg, AB12 cutting ~82.6 kg) let the pilot check reproduction; the pilot is a code and resource check, not a blind test. The +/-4.9 % band rests on 5 calibration trials and 3 out-of-sample trials, all level walking; its validity for other gait families is assumed, not shown.
tolerance.screen: Post hoc (after the census and the verifier's round 1), rules fixed in code (SCREEN_RULES, stamped 19:03:47Z) before the 61 trials were re-read: min 10 gait stances (from the census per-stance spread: 90th-percentile robust log sd 0.047; (0.047/0.0152)^2 = 9.7; any threshold 5-11 gives the same split because matched trials have 4 or >= 11 stances); second estimator within 0.0488 log of the matched mass and nearest to it. My own implementation, written without reading the verifier's code. Exact trials not screened.

decisions.question: Only some GT23 trials have a clearly identified divisor. Which GT23 trials should carry moments and powers rescaled to the participant's own mass? Trials not rescaled keep kinematics and forces; their moments and powers are withheld.

options.label: Withhold kinetics for every GT23 trial
options.consequence: Returns to the withhold option for GT23. Kinematics and forces released; no GT23 moments or powers. Nothing estimated. Reversible.

options.label: Rescale the 25 well-separated matches
options.consequence: Moments and powers rescaled to own mass for 25 trials (exact or matched by two estimators, at least 10 stances, no other recorded mass near the band edge). Other trials keep kinematics and forces; their moments and powers are withheld. Reversible.

options.label: Rescale all 35 matches
options.consequence: As the previous option plus 10 matches with another recorded mass just outside the 5 % band, so a few factors may be off by 5-10 %. These include AB07 cutting and AB07 tire-run, the only tire-run and cutting matches kept; in the other 6 the second estimator reads 4.6-15.2 % low. Other trials keep kinematics and forces; their moments and powers are withheld. Reversible.

decisions.options_order: By GT23 trials released with kinetics: 0, 25, 35.
decisions.why: The 25 trials are exact or matched by two independent estimators with enough stances and no recorded mass at the band edge; the other 10 matches could be a neighbouring mass, which would make their factor wrong by 5-10 %.
decisions.check: Sheet, first figure: AB11's bar has no blue part, so none of its trials would get rescaled kinetics under B or C.
decisions.cost_of_waiting: GT23 moments and powers stay out of any release; GT23 kinematics, forces and other datasets are unaffected.
